analysis:
Only docs/architecture/inference.md was supplied, as base lines 796-1045 and head lines 1-399. No patch hunks or line mapping were provided, so changes could not be diffed. Nothing in either excerpt is executable code, key handling, a wire format, or an authorization, attestation, encryption or billing control.

Head doc claims examined:
- Deadline admission no longer applies a fixed 0.5 rate multiplier (head ~295-299). Elapsed-deadline expiry and physical admission still apply. This is a documented availability and routing-latency policy and does not touch A-001 confidentiality or the TB-002 boundary.
- Calibration and startup warmup are local-only and excluded from rate training and counters (head ~123-186).
- Audio requests are rejected for unsupported architectures before model acquisition, and encrypted ingress uses provider-owned metadata (head 190-201). This is consistent with the existing fail-closed posture.
- The prefix-cache docs point to prefix-cache.md and no cache semantics change in these excerpts. T-041 (SSD tier, 30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup tags, account-scoped salt) is not contradicted. No TTL, gate or crypto change is stated in the visible lines.

Base doc lines 796-1045 cover MiMo media decode-memory accounting, in-memory video assets with no disk write, and the coordinator-serving channel. Nothing in them is contradicted by the visible head text, but the head excerpt does not reach those lines.

Coverage limit: the head excerpt stops at line 399, so any security-relevant doc edits beyond that (including the MiMo, T-050 and cache sections) were not seen. A later pass should check whether the doc-only change alters the T-041 TTL, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gating or T-050 temp-file statements.
